title: The Daily Five
dek: Five verified questions from a wild Saturday: a ten-goal bronze final, a shootout in Netanya, a record-breaking triple-double and Maccabi Haifa's busy window.

questions.question: What was the final score of the World Cup third-place match between England and France?
questions.explanation: England won a ten-goal epic 6–4 in Miami Gardens, with a Bukayo Saka hat-trick and a stoppage-time Jude Bellingham goal.

questions.question: How did Hapoel Tel Aviv beat Beitar Jerusalem in the Toto Cup quarter-final?
questions.explanation: Daniel Dappa equalised in the 96th minute and goalkeeper Assaf Tzur saved three spot-kicks in the shootout.

questions.question: What was Rany Belaga's historic statline in Israel U20's 96–74 win over Latvia?
questions.explanation: The captain's 16-12-10 was reported as the first triple-double by an Israeli at the FIBA U20 EuroBasket.

questions.question: Whose all-time World Cup scoring record did Kylian Mbappé pass in the bronze final?
questions.explanation: Mbappé's brace took him to 22 career World Cup goals, one past Messi's 21 — with Messi still to play in Sunday's final.

questions.question: For which reported fee did Maccabi Haifa sell midfielder Show to Kocaelispor?
questions.explanation: The Angolan midfielder's permanent move to the Turkish top flight was announced at a reported €500,000, paid in instalments.
